caption:
Open the Gemini app on your phone. Tap the toggle to switch from Chat to Task mode. This activates the new Duplex voice feature.

You can use it to schedule appointments, analyze utility bills, and purchase items through integrated services. The free update is available in the United States, Japan, Korea, Canada, Australia, and India.

Save this for later when you need to handle errands without the phone.
